instruction.sound: You will hear short quotes. Listen and choose if the statements below are true or false.

Many of my friends took a gap year after school. For me, however, that was never an option, mainly for financial reasons. I only took a short summer vacation and then started my carpenter apprenticeship straight away.

atoms.a: The speaker began studying at university after her vacation.

wrong.text:
She started an apprenticeship.


“Many of my friends took a gap year after school. For me, however, that was never an option, mainly for financial reasons. I only took a short summer vacation and then started my carpenter apprenticeship straight away.”

apprenticeship – Berufslehre
carpenter – Tischler, Schreiner

instruction.sound: I’m predicted to finish my A-Levels with top grades and have a Medicine offer from the University of Leeds. I've also been offered a photography internship in London. That's why I decided to defer university and try photography for a year.

atoms.a: The speaker decided not to study at university for now.

wrong.text:
He chose to try photography instead.


“I’m predicted to finish my A-Levels with top grades and have a Medicine offer from the University of Leeds. At the same time, I’ve been offered a photography internship in London. That's why I decided to defer university and try photography for a year.”

internship – Praktikum
to defer – verschieben

instruction.sound: I’m currently preparing for the Joint Entrance Examination because I want to study agricultural engineering and innovate sustainable farming. Sometimes the stress of studying feels overwhelming but then I remind myself why I want to do this.

atoms.a: The speaker feels unprepared for JEE.

wrong.text:
She does not say anything about feeling unprepared.


“I’m currently preparing for the Joint Entrance Examination because I want to study agricultural engineering and innovate sustainable farming. Sometimes the stress of studying feels overwhelming but then I remind myself why I want to do this.”

instruction.sound: I've got a place in a rugby academy in Auckland. It’s a great opportunity, but also meant leaving my family in Rotorua. Initially, I worried about being far from my community but they have encouraged me to give professional Rugby a go.

atoms.a: The speaker decided to stay with his family in Rotorua.

wrong.text:
He is pursuing a professional Rugby career in Auckland.


“I've got a place in a rugby academy in Auckland. It’s a great opportunity, but also meant leaving my family in Rotorua. Initially, I worried about being far from my community but they have encouraged me to give professional Rugby a go.”

to give sth. a go – etw. eine Chance geben/auspropieren
to encourage – ermutigen
